title: 4Sum II
description: Find number of tuples (i, j, k, l) such that nums1[i] + nums2[j] + nums3[k] + nums4[l] == 0.
pseudocode:
1. map = {}
2. for a in nums1: for b in nums2: map[a+b]++
3. count = 0
4. for c in nums3: for d in nums4: if -(c+d) in map: count += map[-(c+d)]
5. return count

steps.note: Initialize empty hash map to store sums of nums1 and nums2.
Check nums3 + nums4: (-1+0)=-1 (target 1 exists in map), (-1+2)=1 (target -1 exists in map).
Check nums3 + nums4: (2+0)=2 (not in map), (2+2)=4 (not in map).
